items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Restinga Sêca (RS) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 90,590.40; proposals close Nov 19, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
